why: The INSO mandatory list (the same file cited for IR-30/IR-49) also lists INSO 13368 (loss limits and energy approval for oil-immersed three-phase distribution transformers 25-25,000 kVA, Um up to 36 kV; Part 1 for <=24 kV).
